records.title: GoodRx Privacy Settlement
records.summary: A proposed privacy settlement for eligible U.S. users of GoodRx websites, apps, or services. Payment depends on approved claims.
records.eligibility: People in the United States who used a GoodRx website, app, or service before April 20, 2024, subject to the exclusions in the official notice. Read that notice before claiming.
records.deadline_label: December 29, 2026, 11:59 p.m. Eastern online; paper claims must be postmarked by December 29.
records.payment: Pro rata; the individual payment amount is not yet known.
records.requirements: Truthful eligibility certification. Complete the official contact details and payment choice, and sign and date the paper form. Check the notice for exclusions. One claim per class member.
records.instructions: For online submission, open the official website and complete its form; you can copy your contact details from here. For mail, download the prefilled official PDF, review both pages, select payment, sign and date, and mail it by the postmark deadline. Email is listed for questions, not as a verified claim submission route.
records.mailing_address:
GoodRx Data Disclosure Settlement
c/o A.B. Data, Ltd.
P.O. Box 173138
Milwaukee, WI 53217

records.title: Amazon Prime FTC Refunds
records.summary: Automatic refunds for eligible Prime customers under the FTC settlement. A claim form is not required.
records.eligibility: U.S. Prime customers affected by the specified enrollment or cancellation processes between June 23, 2019 and June 23, 2025, and meeting the usage limits. Review the FTC page for the full conditions.
records.payment: The FTC describes refunds up to $200 total for eligible customers; individual entitlement varies.
records.deadline_label: Automatic payments continuing through April 2027; accept payments within 60 days of issue.
records.instructions: No claim form is needed. Read the FTC instructions and watch for an automatic payment if eligible. Do not send a preparation copy as a claim. For missing-payment questions, use the contact on the official FTC page.
